findings.text: Installed mods run from a cache copy, so edits in D:\Agents\main\mods apply only after 'claude plugin update' and a new session.
This session still runs its temporary mod copies; if it reloads plugins, each mod could load twice.
Branch codex/exam-ux-refresh is 19 commits ahead of main, including the whole backend; main lacks them.
A large block of competition-management work (participants, eligibility, winners, campaigns) is still uncommitted.
NBC_ADMIN_OPEN=true in production removes the staff sign-in wall on /admin, exposing participant data to anyone with the URL.
Local checkout is one commit behind origin/main (fa26a77); the uncommitted management work is based on 15a42ae and may conflict.
Production has OTP_PROVIDER=unifonic but no UNIFONIC_APP_SID or OTP_SENDER_ID, so real SMS sign-in cannot work yet.
The band's SVG sizes are fixed widths (220px or 140px) and haven't been checked against the real desktop band width.
NBC_ADMIN_OPEN=true is still set in production, leaving /admin open without staff sign-in.
The capsule's label is SVG text in a plain image; if the system font is missing, it falls back to another font and may fit differently.
Command-line Claude's sign-in has expired, so headless test runs fail; mod loading can only be checked through desktop sessions.
Mods updated mid-session stay on the old version until the session restarts or /reload-plugins runs, which hides UI changes.
NBC_ADMIN_OPEN=true is live in production: anyone with the URL can use the admin panel and APIs.
Status.md and Roadmap say the branch isn't merged or deployed, but main already holds it and fa26a77 is live.
